scope: Tunisia medical discovery — University of Tunis El Manar Faculty of Medicine of Tunis

verifiedFacts.claim: The Faculty of Medicine of Tunis publishes its medical curriculum objectives and states that hospital placements are a cornerstone of training and curriculum validation.
The same official curriculum page describes specialist-doctor training as four to five years depending on the chosen specialty, after the undergraduate medical route.

Tunisia's Ministry of Higher Education published 2026 national university-orientation information, but no Faculty of Medicine of Tunis route-specific international admission page was established in this review.

holdReasons: No current route-specific medicine tuition, admissions requirements/timeline, or international applicant evidence was established.
No current independent programme recognition/accreditation evidence was established for the necessary recognition badges.
A complete degree-award, curriculum-duration, clinical placement, accommodation and international-support evidence packet was not completed.
nextAction: Obtain current official first-cycle medical programme, international-admission and fee evidence, then independently verify recognition/accreditation and student-support arrangements before packaging.
